is_mandatory.quote: A surety, bail bond agency, or producer is prohibited from paying a fee or commission, or otherwise giving or promising anything of value, to a person for selling, soliciting, or negotiating a bail bond if the person is not properly licensed as a producer.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Charging a premium lower than the surety's filed rate (outside permitted exceptions).
disciplinary_grounds.quote: a producer must charge the approved, filed rate of the surety being used to post a bail bond. Except as provided in subdivision 2 or in a situation where cash bail is set by the court under subdivision 5, the rate charged must not be less than the surety's filed rate.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Providing a premium rebate to a client.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A producer is prohibited from providing a premium rebate.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Posting a bond without collecting the required minimum percentage of premium (50% for bonds ≤$10,000; 30% for bonds >$10,000).
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A producer is prohibited from posting a bail bond with a penal sum of $10,000 or less unless the producer has: (1) received at least 50 percent of the total premium owed under the surety's rate filing

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to assign debt or file civil action within 20 days when a promissory note payment is more than 90 days late.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: If a payment, including a minimum monthly payment, that is required under a promissory note executed pursuant to subdivision 3 or 4 is more than 90 days late, the bail bond agency or producer must, within 20 days of the date a payment becomes 90 days late

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to deposit premiums received into a premium trust account within seven business days.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A payment made to or received by the producer, bail bond agency, or surety must be deposited into a premium trust account that is maintained by the producer, bail bond agency, or surety within seven business days.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to provide a written and numbered receipt to the depositor when collateral is accepted.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: When collateral is accepted, the producer, surety, or bail bond agency must provide a written and numbered receipt to the depositor.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Using collateral for personal benefit or gain.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A surety, bail bond agency, or producer is prohibited from using collateral for personal benefit or gain.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Taking a quitclaim deed on real property as collateral for a bond.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A surety, bail bond agency, or producer is prohibited from taking a quitclaim deed on real property as collateral for a bond.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Soliciting, distributing advertising, or loitering in or on the grounds of jails, prisons, or courts without invitation.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A producer is prohibited from, in or on the grounds of a jail, prison, or other location where an incarcerated person is confined, or in or on the grounds of a court unless requested by the principal, a potential indemnitor, or the legal counsel of a principal: (1) approaching, enticing, inviting, or soliciting a person to use a bail bond agency's services

disciplinary_grounds.description: Paying a fee, commission, or thing of value to a jailer, police officer, peace officer, judge, public official, or public employee in connection with bail bond business.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: a surety, bail bond agency, or producer is prohibited from paying a fee or commission, or otherwise giving or promising anything of value, to: (1) a jailer, police officer, peace officer, or any other person who has the power to arrest or hold an individual in custody; or (2) a judge, public official, or public employee.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Paying a fee or rebate, or giving anything of value, to the individual seeking bail bond services.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A surety, bail bond agency, or producer is prohibited from paying a fee or rebate, or otherwise giving or promising anything of value, to the individual seeking the producer's services or the individual seeking the producer's services on another individual's behalf.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Paying a fee or commission to an unlicensed person for selling, soliciting, or negotiating a bail bond.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A surety, bail bond agency, or producer is prohibited from paying a fee or commission, or otherwise giving or promising anything of value, to a person for selling, soliciting, or negotiating a bail bond if the person is not properly licensed as a producer.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Paying a fee, rebate, or commission to an inmate for referring business or for any reason related to soliciting, negotiating, or selling a bail bond.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A surety, bail bond agency, or producer is prohibited from paying a fee, rebate, or commission, or otherwise giving or promising anything of value, to an inmate for referring business or for any other reason related to soliciting, negotiating, or selling a bail bond.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to maintain required bond records for at least seven years after bond termination.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A bail bond agency and producer must maintain the following records on each bond for at least seven years after the date the bond is terminated

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to sign the required compliance certification form during the surety's annual audit.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: During the surety's annual audit of a producer, the producer must sign a compliance certification form that attests to the producer's compliance with this chapter during the previous calendar year.

surrender_of_principal_rules.quote: The courts, jails, and sheriff offices in Minnesota must comply with section 629.63, allowing for a principal to be surrendered and received by the jail of the county that the bail bond was originated from and to be held in custody until the principal can have a court hearing where the surety, bail bond agency, or producer can give evidence and make motion for the revocation and discharge of the bail bond.

forfeiture_notice_and_reinstatement_dead.quote: The court must order a bail bond forfeited and send notice to the surety, bail bond agency, or producer no later than 30 days from the date of a principal failing to appear at a scheduled hearing. If a court fails to forfeit a bail bond within 30 days of a principal failing to appear or fail to send notice within seven days of the forfeiture to the surety, bail bond agency, or producer, the court must allow for a reinstatement and discharge of the bail bond without penalty.
